definitions.explanation: Having a bright, positive personality; open and pleasant.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{朗|ほが}らかな{性格|せいかく}だ。
{朗|ほが}らかな{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}が{聞|き}こえる。

notes:
{朗|ほが}らか is a na-adjective describing a cheerful, bright, and open personality or atmosphere.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {朗|ほが}らかな + noun
- Adverb: {朗|ほが}らかに (cheerfully)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朗|ほが}らかな{性格|せいかく}: cheerful personality
- {朗|ほが}らかな{笑顔|えがお}: bright smile
- {朗|ほが}らかな{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}: cheerful laughter
- {朗|ほが}らかに{話|はな}す: to speak cheerfully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {明|あか}るい: bright, cheerful (more common)
- {陽気|ようき}: cheerful, lively
- {快活|かいかつ}: lively, cheerful

USAGE:
{朗|ほが}らか has a somewhat literary or refined quality compared to {明|あか}るい. It emphasizes an open, sunny disposition that puts others at ease.
